spec.title: Similar Logs
spec.description: Top 10 nearest log entries by embedding distance

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    eventhub_timestamp,
    category,
    log_raw,
    embedding_vector <=> COALESCE(
        NULLIF('${embedding_vector}', 'pending')::vector,
        (SELECT e2.embedding_vector FROM enriched_logs e2 WHERE e2.embedding_vector IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1)
    ) AS distance
FROM enriched_logs
WHERE eventhub_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '6 hour'
  AND category != 'kernel'
ORDER BY distance
LIMIT 10;
